thought.text: Memory is flat but no server up after 8 min — something is stuck. Let me investigate:

reasoning_content: Weird — memory available is flat (about 1.3GB), and the servers still haven't started after 8 minutes. That means the build process isn't consuming much memory. Let me check what's going on.

action.command: tail -5 /tmp/serve-final.log; echo "=== build procs ==="; ps aux | grep -E "run-executor|nx.js|esbuild" | grep -v grep | awk '{printf "pid=%s rss=%sMB cpu=%s%% %s\n",$2,int($6/1024),$3,$11}' | head -8; echo "=== app.log ==="; tail -4 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/app.log
